mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_SYNC_BATCH (ID, BATCH_NO, SYNC_TYPE, STATUS, CURSOR_BEFORE, CURSOR_AFTER, RECEIVED_COUNT, SUCCESS_COUNT, FAILURE_COUNT, ERROR_MESSAGE, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{batchNo}, #{syncType}, #{status}, #{cursorBefore}, #{cursorAfter}, #{receivedCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE PT_SYNC_BATCH SET STATUS = 'RUNNING', ERROR_MESSAGE = NULL, STARTED_AT = #{startedAt}, FINISHED_AT = NULL WHERE BATCH_NO = #{batchNo}
UPDATE PT_SYNC_BATCH SET STATUS = #{status}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, FINISHED_AT = #{finishedAt} WHERE BATCH_NO = #{batchNo}
mapper.select: SELECT LAST_CURSOR FROM PT_SYNC_STATE WHERE TASK_CODE = #{taskCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE PT_SYNC_STATE SET LAST_CURSOR = #{cursor}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE TASK_CODE = #{taskCode}
